title: 第17章 那个杂役弟子怎么跑这儿来了第18章 顾长老点名
content_zh:
纯小白见这个家伙，动作一下变得这么敏捷，好奇地侧过头。
一张熟悉的秀气小脸映入眼帘。
“咦！这脸蛋，这身段，怎么看着有些眼熟？”
对面的白师妹，目光也恰好落在了纯小白身上，她也发现了纯小白似曾相识。
“我去，这不是前天带我入门的小姑娘吗？”
白锦儿也认出了他：“这不是前天那个贼眉鼠眼的杂役弟子吗？”
“他……他怎么跑这儿来了？”
纯小白看到她眼中的疑惑，心中猛地一突：“卧槽，要穿帮！”
他想都没想，赶紧把脑袋往另一边一撇，装作不认识。
“你！给我转过身来！”白锦儿的声音带着一丝惊疑。
“白师妹，不得无礼，”方元赶紧打圆场，“这位可是新来的纯师兄。”
“纯师兄？！”
白锦儿眨巴着一双大眼睛，愣了愣。
他……他是师兄？
她可是知道方元的性格，只结交比他厉害的师兄。
他自己还是一位实打实的炼气七层，听这口气……
难不成这杂役弟子是一位炼气八层的师兄？
不对！
这家伙前天才上山，怎么可能境界提升这么快，一下子就窜到炼气八层了？
“方师兄！你别被这个家伙骗了！他就是个杂……”

“杂什么杂？”
没等她说完，纯小白直接坐直了身子，瞪着眼喝道，“你这小姑娘怎么这么没礼貌？上来就要骂本大王是杂碎？”
这突如其来的一嗓子，中气十足，匪气冲天。
白锦儿被他吼的吓了一跳，到了嘴边的话硬生生噎了回去。
方元也没想到这位纯师兄脾气这么爆，赶紧上前一步，挡在两人中间，赔笑道：
“纯师兄息怒，息怒！白师妹她年轻不懂事，不是那个意思。”
“不懂事也不能随便骂人！”纯小白理直气壮，梗着脖子坐在那里，跟个斗鸡似的瞪着白锦儿。
“也就是本大王脾气好，换做旁人，早把你扔出去了！”
白锦儿一下子僵在原地，眼神在纯小白和方元之间来回打转，随后心里犯起了嘀咕。
这个家伙……到底是不是那个杂役？
理智告诉她不太可能。
毕竟这里可是外门传功堂，门规森严，哪有这么胆肥的杂役，敢跑到这里来冒充外门弟子？
content_en:
Seeing how agile this guy was, Chun Xiaobai turned his head curiously.
A familiar, delicate face came into view.
"Hey! Why does this face and figure look familiar?"
Junior Sister Bai opposite, her eyes happened to fall on Chun Xiaobai, and she also found that Chun Xiaobai looked familiar.
"I'll go, isn't this the little girl who showed me the door the day before yesterday?"
Bai Jin'er also recognized him: "Isn't this the handyman disciple with sly eyebrows and sly eyes the day before yesterday?"
"He...why did he come here?"
Seeing the confusion in her eyes, Chun Xiaobai's heart suddenly thought: "Damn it, I'm trying to trick someone!"
Without thinking, he quickly turned his head to the other side and pretended not to recognize him.
"You! Turn around!" Bai Jin'er's voice was filled with a hint of surprise.
"Junior Sister Bai, please don't be rude," Fang Yuan quickly smoothed things over, "This is the new Senior Brother Chun."
"Brother Chun?!"
Bai Jin'er blinked her big eyes and was stunned.
He...he is a senior brother?
She knew Fang Yuan's character and only made friends with senior brothers who were better than him.
He himself is still a solid seventh-level Qi refiner, and listening to this tone...
Could it be that this handyman disciple is a senior at the eighth level of Qi refining?
wrong!
This guy only went up the mountain the day before yesterday. How could it be possible that his realm had improved so quickly and he had reached the eighth level of Qi Refining all of a sudden?
"Senior Brother Fang! Don't be deceived by this guy! He is just an idiot..."
"What kind of things are there?"
Before she could finish speaking, Chun Xiaobai sat up straight, glared and shouted, "Why are you so rude, little girl? Are you going to call me a bastard?"
This sudden voice was full of energy and gangsterism.
Bai Jin'er was startled by his roar, and choked back the words that came to her lips.
Fang Yuan did not expect that Senior Brother Chun would have such a bad temper, so he quickly stepped forward, stood between the two of them, and said with an apologetic smile:
"Senior Brother Chun, calm down, calm down! Junior Sister Bai is young and ignorant, that's not what she meant."
"You can't curse people casually if you don't understand!" Chun Xiaobai said confidently, sitting there with his neck hunched over, staring at Bai Jin'er like a fighting cock.
"That is to say, this king has a good temper. If it were anyone else, I would have thrown you out a long time ago!"
Bai Jin'er suddenly froze on the spot, his eyes darting back and forth between Chun Xiaobai and Fang Yuan, and then he started to murmur in his heart.
Is this guy... the handyman?
Reason told her that it was impossible.
After all, this is the outer sect's martial arts hall, and the rules are strict. How could such a timid servant dare to come here and pretend to be an outer sect disciple?
